events.title: The martyrdom of Archbishop Óscar Romero
events.shortBlurb: The archbishop of San Salvador was shot dead at the altar the day after pleading with soldiers to stop killing their people…
body: On 24 March 1980, Archbishop Óscar Romero of San Salvador was shot through the heart as he celebrated Mass in the chapel of a hospital for the dying, moments after preaching. The day before, in a broadcast homily, he had appealed to the soldiers of El Salvador, in the name of God, to cease the repression and killing of the poor.

A once-cautious bishop, Romero had become an outspoken defender of the poor and of human rights amid his country's descent into civil war. His death made him a symbol of the Church's witness in Latin America; he was beatified as a martyr in 2015 and canonized by Pope Francis in 2018.

sources.text: Vatican biography, Canonization of St. Óscar Romero (vatican.va)
